svg.aria-label: The detector moves from idle to armed when GPS speed stays above 25 km/h, opens an event on a range-capped dynamic acceleration of 4 g, judges it eight seconds later, and alerts only if all four gates pass; each gate rejects a specific false-alarm scenario.
svg.title: Phone crash detector: states and the four gates
